T-001.Title: Remove the defect-corpus filename exemption and keep the explicit marker

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Red-first, before the runtime change: in `src/review/core.test.ts` add discriminating controls that drive `runPatternDetectors` (and `runReview` where the exemption report is under test) over synthetic projects. Place the same unmarked markup-guard fixture bytes at the exact filename `src/test-support/defect-corpus.ts`, at a substring basename `src/fixture-defect-corpus-copy.ts`, at a substring directory `src/defect-corpus-fixtures/guard.ts`, and at an ordinary name, and assert each yields the ordinary `review.regex-over-structure` finding with severity `error`. On the current tree the three `defect-corpus`-containing paths are exempt and silent while the ordinary path refuses; witness and retain that genuine red output with direct exits. Record truthful fail→pass provenance during EXECUTE; private mutants that restore the filename bypass are non-vacuity evidence only, not production failure attempts.

In `src/review/core.ts`, inside `fileHoldsShapesAsData`, remove only the `rel.includes("defect-corpus")` branch and its comment, and drop the now-unused private `rel` path parameter together with the sole call's path argument at the detector loop. The helper's remaining body tests `text.includes(SHAPE_DATA_MARKER)`. Preserve `SHAPE_DATA_MARKER`, file-level opt-in semantics, and the visible `shapeDataExemptions` reporting exactly. Do not modify the scan population (`.ts`/`.js` under `src`, `.test.ts` excluded), `usesRegexAsGuard`, `extractRegexPatternSources`, `patternSourceLooksLikeMarkupGuard`, `isDefectiveUnstrippedMarkerLineGuard`, the finding code `review.regex-over-structure`, its `error` severity, its `markup-or-attribute-regex-guard` rule id, or the report shape.

In `src/test-support/defect-corpus.ts`, add the existing explicit marker `@ngrace-review-shape-data` as a comment describing the module's internal fixture-data role, placed outside the generated source strings this module emits (the structural predicates that appear in emitted defective code, e.g. a generated `<Item id="…">`-style guard literal, are data, not runtime guards — the comment must not be written into a generated string). The module stays exempt and appears in `shapeDataExemptions`. Preserve stable defect ids, generated fixture bytes, expected findings, and executable behavior; `bun test --timeout=0 src/test-support/defect-corpus.test.ts` continues to pass (unique ids, per-pattern coverage, clean pre-apply baseline, declared rationales, surface reachability fields, and `apply()` mutation). No corpus count or historical conformance population is pinned.

Discriminators and preserved controls, proved by synthetic fixtures and the real source CLI with honest provenance (mutate→observed→exact restoration): (a) identical unmarked guard bytes under the exact `defect-corpus.ts` filename, a substring basename, a substring directory, and an ordinary name each produce exactly one `review.regex-over-structure` finding with severity `error` and rule id `markup-or-attribute-regex-guard`, and none of those paths appears in `shapeDataExemptions`; (b) a legitimately marked fixture-data module is not flagged and is visibly listed in `shapeDataExemptions` and `summary.shapeDataExemptions` while an adjacent unmarked real guard raises; (c) on marker-triggering fixture data, removing only the marker exposes both files and restoring the exact marker bytes restores the prior report byte-for-byte on the original root and input; (d) the separate marker-line guard keeps its existing `unstripped-marker-line-guard` rule id, and benign unmarked data need not raise. Byte comparison supports one-input-changed-and-restored claims only; do not require output bytes or finding ids to stay equal across different filenames. Existing generalization, refusal, dataflow, and exemption-reporting checks are retained, not deleted to obtain green.

The change is surgical and complete: no second filename/path/root/directory exemption, configuration key, suppression list, override flag, new export, parser/detector redesign, or marker-syntax change is introduced; the only remaining exemption is the explicit `@ngrace-review-shape-data` file marker. The task's resulting-tree instruments are `bun test --timeout=0 src/review/core.test.ts` and `bun test --timeout=0 src/test-support/defect-corpus.test.ts`; the whole-suite and applied-archive checks are later, distinct states owned by the close-bound criteria.
